title: Willing · adj
subtitle: 「願意的／準備好去做的／傾向接受的」，究竟是哪一種 willing？
description: 「願意的／準備好去做的／傾向接受的」，究竟是哪一種 willing？

words.note: 當 willing 指某人已願意採取行動、接受任務或作出某種改變時很自然；但 ready 也可表示實際準備完成，所以要看語境。
words.example: She is ready to help if the team needs extra support.
words.exampleZh: 如果團隊需要額外支援，她願意幫忙。

exercises.original: She is willing to stay late if the project needs more time.
exercises.zh: 如果項目需要更多時間，她願意留下來加班。
exercises.upgrade: ready · 願意的；準備好去做的

options.explanation: able = 她可能有能力留下來，但原句重點是意願。
eager = 沒有顯示她非常期待加班。
ready = 她已表示願意採取行動，ready to 可自然表達。
required = 這不是被強制要求。
confident = 和是否願意留下無關。

exercises.original: He is willing to take responsibility for the final decision.
exercises.zh: 他願意為最終決定承擔責任。
exercises.upgrade: ready · 願意的；準備好去做的

options.explanation: interested = 對責任有興趣不等於願意承擔。
obedient = 承擔責任不是服從命令。
ready = 願意正式承擔責任時，ready to 很自然。
able = 有能力和願意不同。

exercises.original: The volunteers are willing to begin as soon as the supplies arrive.
exercises.zh: 物資一到，義工就願意開始。
exercises.upgrade: ready · 願意的；準備好去做的

options.explanation: required = 義工通常不是因義務而做。
confident = 不表示是否願意開始。
available = 可以有空，但不等於已願意開始。
interested = 不表示已準備採取行動。
ready = as soon as 顯示他們願意立即行動，ready 很自然。

words.note: 當 willing 出現在 be prepared to do something 結構中，表示某人願意承擔代價、責任或採取某行動時很自然；語氣比 ready 稍正式。
words.example: The company is prepared to revise the plan if necessary.
words.exampleZh: 如有需要，公司願意修訂計劃。

exercises.original: The landlord is willing to reduce the rent slightly for a longer lease.
exercises.zh: 如果租期較長，業主願意稍微降低租金。
exercises.upgrade: prepared · 願意的；準備承擔的

options.explanation: eager = 沒有證據顯示業主很想減租。
required = 並非被要求必須減租。
prepared = 在談判中表示願意作出讓步，prepared to 很典型。
able = 可能做得到，但重點是願不願意。
interested = 不表示接受這個交換條件。

exercises.original: The company is willing to invest more if demand continues to grow.
exercises.zh: 如果需求持續增長，公司願意增加投資。
exercises.upgrade: prepared · 願意的；準備承擔的

options.explanation: confident = 公司是否有信心不是核心。
available = 不合公司投資意願。
eager = 條件式承諾未必帶熱切語氣。
prepared = 條件成立時願意採取下一步，正式商務語境可用 prepared to。
able = 有資金能力不等於願意投資。

exercises.original: She is willing to accept a temporary transfer if it helps the team.
exercises.zh: 如果有助團隊，她願意接受臨時調職。
exercises.upgrade: prepared · 願意的；準備承擔的

options.explanation: interested = 對調職有興趣不等於願意接受。
eager = 沒有顯示她非常期待。
prepared = 願意承擔某個安排或代價，prepared to accept 很自然。

words.note: 當 willing 指某人傾向接受某個想法、選項或行動，而不是完全確定時可用；語氣較含蓄。
words.example: I am inclined to accept the revised proposal.
words.exampleZh: 我傾向接受修訂後的提案。

exercises.original: I am willing to support the proposal, although I still have some concerns.
exercises.zh: 雖然仍有一些疑慮，我傾向支持這項提案。
exercises.upgrade: inclined · 傾向於；有意願的

options.explanation: eager = 仍有疑慮，不像 eager 那麼積極。
inclined = 有正面傾向但仍保留疑慮，inclined to 最精確。

exercises.original: She seems willing to choose the cheaper option.
exercises.zh: 她似乎傾向選擇較便宜的選項。
exercises.upgrade: inclined · 傾向於；有意願的

options.explanation: interested = 可能感興趣，但不等於選擇傾向。
inclined = seems 配合較含蓄的選擇傾向，inclined 很自然。

exercises.original: The committee is willing to accept a compromise rather than delay the vote.
exercises.zh: 委員會傾向接受折衷，而不是延遲投票。
exercises.upgrade: inclined · 傾向於；有意願的

options.explanation: inclined = 在兩個選項間表達較可能的取向，最適合 inclined。
eager = 折衷通常不帶熱切感。

words.note: 較正式，常見於 be disposed to，表示某人對某種行動、態度或選擇抱有正面傾向；比 inclined 更書面。
words.example: The board seems disposed to approve the request.
words.exampleZh: 董事會似乎傾向批准這項要求。

exercises.original: The panel appears willing to approve the revised application.
exercises.zh: 評審小組似乎傾向批准修訂後的申請。
exercises.upgrade: disposed · 有意願的；傾向於

options.explanation: eager = 沒有熱切批准的語氣。
required = panel 並非被迫批准。
disposed = 正式地表達權威機構傾向採取某決定，disposed to 很合適。

exercises.original: Senior managers seem willing to consider a shorter trial period.
exercises.zh: 高層管理人員似乎願意考慮較短的試行期。
exercises.upgrade: disposed · 有意願的；傾向於

options.explanation: disposed = 較書面地表示對方案持正面傾向，可用 disposed to。
able = 是否有能力考慮不是問題。

exercises.original: The court was willing to allow additional time in exceptional cases.
exercises.zh: 法院願意在特殊情況下給予額外時間。
exercises.upgrade: disposed · 有意願的；傾向於

options.explanation: interested = 法院不是對此『有興趣』。
disposed = 正式法律／權威語境中表達願意作出某裁量，disposed to 可用。
eager = 權威機構語境下過於熱切。

words.meaning: 願意配合的；樂於接受的
words.note: 當 willing 指某人願意聽取建議、接受安排、配合改變或合作時很自然；常見於 amenable to。
words.example: Most staff were amenable to the proposed schedule change.
words.exampleZh: 大部分員工都願意接受建議中的時間表改動。

exercises.original: The staff are willing to try the new rota for one month.
exercises.zh: 員工願意試行新的輪班表一個月。
exercises.upgrade: amenable · 願意配合的；樂於接受的

options.explanation: amenable = 願意配合新安排、接受試行，最自然用 amenable to。
available = 有空不代表接受新安排。

exercises.original: The client was willing to accept several small changes in the design.
exercises.zh: 客戶願意接受設計上的幾項小改動。
exercises.upgrade: amenable · 願意配合的；樂於接受的

options.explanation: interested = 對改動有興趣不等於願意接受。
amenable = 對修改持開放和配合態度，amenable to 很自然。
obedient = 客戶不是服從命令。

exercises.original: Most residents were willing to accept the proposal once the parking issue was resolved.
exercises.zh: 停車問題解決後，大部分居民都願意接受這項提案。
exercises.upgrade: amenable · 願意配合的；樂於接受的

options.explanation: amenable = 問題解決後對 proposal 變得願意接受，amenable to 最精確。

words.note: 當 willing 指某人對一個安排、條件或建議表示同意、願意接受時可用；常見於較正式或禮貌語境。
words.example: Both sides were agreeable to a short extension.
words.exampleZh: 雙方都願意接受短期延期。

exercises.original: Both sides are willing to accept a two-week extension.
exercises.zh: 雙方都願意接受延長兩星期。
exercises.upgrade: agreeable · 願意接受的；同意的

options.explanation: agreeable = 雙方都接受某安排，較正式可用 agreeable to。
eager = 不一定熱切，只是同意。

exercises.original: The owner was willing to accept the proposed payment schedule.
exercises.zh: 業主願意接受建議中的付款時間表。
exercises.upgrade: agreeable · 願意接受的；同意的

options.explanation: interested = 感興趣不等於接受。
agreeable = 對具體條件表示同意，agreeable to 很自然。

exercises.original: The committee said it would be willing to accept a minor wording change.
exercises.zh: 委員會表示願意接受一項小幅措辭修改。
exercises.upgrade: agreeable · 願意接受的；同意的

options.explanation: agreeable = 正式地表示可接受某項小修改，agreeable to 很合適。

words.meaning: 願意考慮；對……持開放態度
words.note: 當 willing 指某人願意考慮新的意見、方案、建議或可能性時非常自然；比 ready 更強調態度上的開放。
words.example: She is open to trying a different approach.
words.exampleZh: 她願意嘗試不同的方法。

exercises.original: She is willing to consider a different approach.
exercises.zh: 她願意考慮不同的方法。
exercises.upgrade: open to · 願意考慮；對……持開放態度

options.explanation: eager = 她只是願意考慮，不一定熱切。
open to = 對另一種方案保持開放態度，open to 是最自然的替換之一。
able = 有能力考慮不等於願意。

exercises.original: The team is willing to listen to feedback from users.
exercises.zh: 團隊願意聽取使用者的回饋。
exercises.upgrade: open to · 願意考慮；對……持開放態度

options.explanation: interested = 可能有興趣，但 open to feedback 更表示願意接受。
open to = open to feedback 是非常常見的固定搭配。

exercises.original: He is willing to changing his mind if new evidence appears.
exercises.zh: 如果出現新證據，他願意改變看法。
exercises.upgrade: open to · 願意考慮；對……持開放態度

options.explanation: able = 有能力改變不等於願意。
open to = 願意在新證據下重新考慮立場，open to changing 很自然。
eager = 沒有顯示他很想改變。

words.meaning: 樂於接受的；願意聽取的
words.note: 當 willing 指某人對建議、意見、批評或新想法抱開放態度時可用；常見於 receptive to。
words.example: The manager was receptive to feedback from the new staff.
words.exampleZh: 經理願意聽取新員工的意見。

exercises.original: The manager was willing to consider suggestions from junior staff.
exercises.zh: 經理願意考慮初級員工的建議。
exercises.upgrade: receptive · 樂於接受的；願意聽取的

options.explanation: eager = 不一定對建議非常興奮。
receptive = 對別人的 suggestions 願意聽取、接受，receptive to 最精確。

exercises.original: The audience seemed willing to consider the speaker's main argument.
exercises.zh: 觀眾似乎願意考慮講者的主要論點。
exercises.upgrade: receptive · 樂於接受的；願意聽取的

options.explanation: interested = 可能感興趣，但 receptive 更表示願意接受其觀點。
receptive = 對 argument 持開放接受態度，receptive to 很自然。

exercises.original: She remained willing to listen to criticism throughout the review.
exercises.zh: 整個評核過程中，她一直願意接受批評。
exercises.upgrade: receptive · 樂於接受的；願意聽取的

options.explanation: confident = 有信心和接受批評不同。
required = 即使評核要求聽取，也不等於真心願意。
eager = 通常不會熱切期待 criticism。
receptive = receptive to criticism 是標準搭配，表示願意聽取負面意見。

falseSynonyms.zh: 有能力不等於 willing able 表示有能力做到；一個人可以有能力，但不願意做。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Able describes capability; willing describes willingness.

falseSynonyms.zh: 渴望不等於一般 willing eager 表示非常想做、充滿期待；willing 只表示願意，不一定興奮。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Eager is stronger and more enthusiastic than willing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有空／可用不等於 willing available 表示有時間、可被使用或可到場；有空的人不一定願意幫忙。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Available concerns availability; willing concerns consent or readiness to act.

falseSynonyms.zh: 被要求不等於 willing required 表示必須做；willing 則表示出於自願。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Required means obligated; willing means voluntarily ready.

falseSynonyms.zh: 服從不等於 willing obedient 表示遵從命令或規則；有時可能並非真正願意。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Obedient describes compliance; willing describes voluntary readiness.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有信心不等於 willing confident 表示相信自己能做好；有信心的人也可能不願意做。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Confident concerns belief in ability; willing concerns consent.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有興趣不一定等於 willing interested 只表示想了解或覺得有吸引力；不一定願意真正採取行動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Interested means curious or attracted; willing means ready to act or agree.

falseSynonyms.zh: 情態／動詞與形容詞不同 will 可作情態動詞或名詞；willing 是形容詞，表示願意的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She will help tomorrow. She is willing to help.
